text.description_html:
Acorn AZC-204-3, Simplicity Stainless Steel 3 Inch Cabinet Pull

This 3 inch Simplicity Stainless Steel Cabinet Pull is a perfect example of how modern design doesn't have to focus on function rather than form. The clean lines of this Acorn cabinet pull look more basic than a traditionally styled cabinet pull yet boring isn't a word that comes to mind while describing it. Sophisticated in design, this cabinet handle is a great way to add a cosmopolitan side to any home without looking as sterile as other contemporary designs can. Available in polished stainless steel or brushed stainless steel finishes.

Also Available: 3.5 Inch Center to Center Simplicity Cabinet Pull, 4 Inch Center to Center Simplicity Cabinet Pull, and Simplicity Stainless Steel Cabinet Knobs

Specifications for the Absolute Zero Collection Simplicity Cabinet Pull Acorn AZC-204:

  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Length (c.c hole spacing): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4.5"
  • Width: 11/16"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Available in polished stainless steel or brushed stainless steel.

Sold Individually
